en-US.name: Stop Scrolling – Duck on Duty
en-US.subtitle: Social Media App Blocker
en-US.description:
Just checking social media? Give yourself a stopping point. The duck blocks each app when its time is up.

• Set a separate usage limit and break for each app.
• Short visits add up. Stay away for a full break to start fresh when Screen Time updates.
• Change next round’s limits during a break.
• Write your own reminder and exit-button text.
• Close the duck. Your limits keep working.

A raised eyebrow. A little humor. The duck is on your side.

Free and ad-free. Your data stays on your iPhone. Requires Screen Time access. Reminder and unlock timing depend on iOS.
en-US.promotional_text: Less social media. More real life. A small duck with independent app timers and mandatory breaks.
en-US.firstScreenshotDetail: The duck blocks the app when you hit your limit.

zh-Hans.name: Duck on Duty – 少刷手机
zh-Hans.subtitle: 少刷社交媒体，每个 App 单独限时
zh-Hans.keywords: 屏幕使用时间,应用限制,防沉迷,自律,专注,戒手机,时间管理,数字健康
captions:
社交媒体，
一刷就停不下来？
zh-Hans.description:
本来只想看一眼，结果又刷了半天？给自己定个停下来的时间。到点鸭子拦住这个 App，让你歇会儿。

• 每个 App，分别设置使用上限和休息时长。
• 多次打开会累计；离开够一轮休息时间，系统更新后重新计时。
• 正在休息，也能改下一轮的时间。
• 提醒的话和退出按钮，都能自己写。
• 关掉鸭子，限时照常。

有点冷幽默，偶尔翻个白眼。鸭子站你这边。

免费，无广告。数据只留在你的 iPhone。需要授权屏幕使用时间；提醒与解锁时机受 iOS 调度影响。
zh-Hans.promotional_text: “再看一条。”行，把时间定好。每个 App 单独计时，到点鸭子接班，你歇会儿。
zh-Hans.firstScreenshotDetail: 到你设的上限，鸭子就拦住这个 App。
